message.text:
The scheduler package contains only a documented example "daily-cleanup" entry at "0 2 * * *". No actual nightly database-cleanup job is scheduled in the codebase.

The background job s3presign runs every 12 hours via time.Ticker in server/server.go. It is not a cron scheduler.
The scheduler is not used in production code across server, cmd, or store modules.

r03.

**Premise correction:** There is no nightly database-cleanup job scheduled in this repository’s cron scheduler, so no run time applies.

`internal/scheduler` defines a cron scheduler (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `internal/scheduler/job.go`), but nothing in `server/`, `cmd/`, or `store/` imports or registers jobs with it. A repo-wide search finds no production `scheduler.New` or `scheduler.Register` calls.

The only “daily-cleanup” / `"0 2 * * *"` (2:00 AM) references are examples in docs and tests (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:14-16`, `internal/scheduler/README.md:34-35`, `internal/scheduler/example_test.go:100`), not wired runtime jobs.

Production background work uses other mechanisms—for example the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour ticker (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-27`, started from `server/server.go:161-169`)—not a nightly DB cleanup cron.
